Validate the continuous random-slope engine

Source: R/validation-mixed.R
simulate_random_slope_continuous_validation.Rd

permanova_random_slope_continuous() tests the equally weighted mean within-group slope of a numeric covariate against the variation among group slopes. For a Euclidean response that is exactly the one-sample test on the per-group ordinary least squares slopes, so the reference here is t.test(slopes) squared.

Usage

simulate_random_slope_continuous_validation(
  simulations = 200L,
  permutations = 99L,
  effect = 0.8,
  groups = 8L,
  occasions = 5L,
  slope_sd = 0.5,
  residual_sd = 0.3,
  alpha = 0.05,
  seed = 20260805L,
  keep_results = FALSE
)

Arguments

simulations

Iterations per scenario.

permutations

Permutations per fit.

effect

Location shift applied in the alternative scenario.

groups

Number of random groups.

occasions

Covariate values observed within every group.

slope_sd

Standard deviation of the group slopes.

residual_sd

Observation-level simulation standard deviation.

alpha

Nominal level.

seed

Base random seed.

keep_results

Retain the per-iteration rows.

Value

An object of class permanova_random_slope_continuous_validation.
